name: Flutter pump
subtitle: a canal pump driven by a swinging sheet

effects.effect: a flexible structure in moving water feeds on the flow and swings harder

effect: a flexible structure in moving water feeds on the flow and swings harder
how: Farms beside canals and streams often sit just a metre or two above the water, so they pay for diesel to lift it. A stiff, hinged sheet anchored in the current starts swinging harder and harder once the flow passes a certain speed (flutter), the way a bridge deck can in wind, and each swing works a piston that lifts water to the fields.
obstacle: Flutter grows until something breaks, so the swing must be held in check day and night without wearing out the hinge.
why: Fuel-free lifting for the many smallholders who farm right beside moving water.
real: US patent 4184805 describes airfoils driven into flutter by a fluid stream with the oscillation used for work including pumping, and flutter hydropower papers mention irrigation channels; no working flutter irrigation pump found.
